svg.title: Weather-adjusted electricity demand: the ten fastest-growing grid regions since 2022

cc:Work.dc:title: Weather-adjusted electricity demand: the ten fastest-growing grid regions since 2022
cc:Work.dc:description: Ten small line charts of weather-adjusted demand indexed to 2019 = 100. Dominion rises to 141; the comparison median stays near 100–105.
